name: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA

(4) TO ASSIST IN THE RECRUITMENT OF ALL MEDICAL AND ANCILLARY PERSONNEL FOR THE SHAUKAT KHANUM MEMORIAL CANCER HOSPITAL AND RESEARCH CENTER.

strengths_deep_dive: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA shows strong financial efficiency in its FY2024 operations. The charity recorded a <cite id="1">98.3% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, ensuring that almost all donor funds directly cover clinical care, diagnostic services, and pharmaceuticals. It operates with low fundraising costs, spending only <cite id="1">$0.09 per $1 raised</cite>. Furthermore, its <cite id="1">9.8 months of working capital</cite> offers strong protection against funding fluctuations.
rich_narrative.summary: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA delivers direct medical relief by funding cancer diagnosis and clinical treatment in Pakistan. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">$23,259,494 in total revenue</cite> to support free healthcare for third-world cancer patients. The charity maintains a strong public profile, backed by a <cite id="1">95/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>. Its financial operations reflect an impressive direct-service model, allocating a <cite id="1">98.3% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, which exceeds the 75% industry benchmark and the 87.7% peer median. The organization is <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, routing donations directly to needy cancer patients (<cite id="2">fuqara and masakin</cite>). However, the charity operates with a limited board structure and lacks a published theory of change or public cost-per-beneficiary metrics.
